messages:
June (marketing): Heads-up: targeting Thurs AM release. Need final changelog URL, docs examples, three short benchmark bullets, and webinar host by EOD Tue. Also want a partner preview window. @Ola can you own demo?
Ola (eng): I can do demo. Plan: live canary flip + metrics dashboard. Need a stable changelog link and a sample request showing the new X-Prefix-Cache header.
Harper (eng): Changelog draft is at https://redwood.internal/changelog/1.7-wip. Added notes re: default_batch and cache-ttl. I'll pin final once docs confirm.
Nadia (docs): I'll update quickstart with curl/python examples and a short migration FAQ. ETA Wed 09:00 PT. Adding legal privacy blurb to both docs and marketing copy.
Ravi (marketing): Marketing bullets: p50 delta, token-cost %, and throughput/tokens-per-second. Cole, can you confirm conservative public numbers for the copy?
Cole (product): Use conservative phrasing: p50 ~40% lower, p95 ~25% lower on typical workloads; unit token cost ~18% lower with caching + batching. I'll DM the exact cells for the marketing spreadsheet.
June (marketing): Webinar 9:30am PT release morning. Ola to demo, Cole does product narrative, June moderates. We need slides + raw CSV for charts and a 15-minute dry run.
Ola (eng): Bench CSV and plots: s3://bench/rls-1767/summary.csv. Will attach cleaned CSV to the slides channel. Canary plan: 2% -> 20% -> full over 90m if healthy. Rollback command in runbook: `rb rollback --id rls-1767 --reason "perf"`.
Ravi (marketing): Inbound CTA: 'Request a demo' should post utm_campaign=rls-1767 and model_hint fields to https://hooks.redwood.com/leads. Sales will route enterprise leads to AEs. Who can smoke-test webhook?
Harper (eng): I'll run a smoke test from staging and paste the curl here. Example: `curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/leads -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"qa+lead@example.com","utm_campaign":"rls-1767","model_hint":"redwood-opt"}'`
preflight-bot: Preflight queued: docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_purge, webhook_smoke_test, webinar_slides. Will post updates.
June (marketing): Final owners: slides (Ravi), demo script (Ola), docs publish (Nadia), changelog pin (Harper), webhook test (Harper), bench confirm (Ola). Partner embargo: do not share before 08:45 PT release day. Dry run Sat 09:00 PT. If blocked, reply here and tag me.
